Recipes Hydroxyurea 1 M in DMSO Dissolve 0.38025 g of hydroxyurea in 5 mL of DMSO Aliquot in small volumes (0.5 mL) and store at -20 °C for up to four months Hypotonic solution 0.075 M KCl in dH 2 O Prewarm the required amount of 0.075 M KCl in a 37 °C water bath before each use Fixative solution Three parts methanol One part glacial acetic acid Make fresh each time Use ice-cold

steps.title: Seed cells for harvest
steps.instruction: Grow cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Seed 0.5 × 10⁶ cells in a 10 cm dish (or 1 × 10⁶ cells in a 15 cm dish for slow‑dividing lines) 48 h before harvest so they reach ~70 % confluence at harvest time.

steps.title: Optional hydroxyurea treatment at seeding
steps.instruction: If desired, add hydroxyurea to the medium at 4 mM (add 40 µL of a 1 M hydroxyurea stock to 10 mL medium for a 10 cm dish) for 3–6 h, wash twice with PBS, then continue culture for ~1.5 cell cycles.

steps.title: Add colcemid before harvest
steps.instruction: Two hours prior to harvest, add colcemid to the culture medium to a final concentration of 0.2 µg/mL (add 200 µL of a 10 µg/mL colcemid stock to 10 mL medium for a 10 cm dish; for a 15 cm dish add 400 µL to 20 mL). Avoid incubation >2 h.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and tubes
steps.instruction: Label 15 mL screw‑cap tubes for each condition, pre‑warm the 0.075 M KCl hypotonic solution to 37 °C, and keep the ice‑cold methanol/acetic acid fixative (3 : 1) at –20 °C.

steps.title: Harvest cells and collect mitotic population
steps.instruction: Collect the medium (and any floating cells) into a 15 mL tube, wash the dish with 5 mL PBS and add the wash to the same tube, then add 1 mL 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 3–5 min at 37 °C until cells detach. Neutralize with 7 mL complete medium, resuspend, and transfer to the tube. Spin 5 min at 186 × g, RT. Remove supernatant, tap tube to loosen pellet, and keep the pellet loose.

steps.title: Swelling in hypotonic solution
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the pellet in 10 mL pre‑warmed hypotonic KCl solution (pipette onto tube wall), incubate 7 min at 37 °C with occasional gentle inversion (5–10 min is typical for HeLa, MEFs, RPE1‑hTERT).

steps.title: First fixation with methanol/acetic acid
steps.instruction: Spin 5 min at 186 × g, RT. Decant KCl, leaving ~0.5 mL. Add 1 mL ice‑cold fixative drop‑wise while vortexing, then fill to 10 mL with fixative. Store at 4 °C overnight or longer (months).

steps.title: Second fixation and resuspension for spreads
steps.instruction: Spin again 5 min at 186 × g, RT. Aspirate fixative leaving 0.5–1 mL, tap to resuspend, and keep tubes on ice.

steps.title: Prepare slides and heating block
steps.instruction: Label frosted glass slides with a pencil, place them in cold water to pre‑cool and wet. Set a 42 °C heating block, cover with wet paper towels, and place a cloth on the bench. Position a 50 mL screw‑cap tube and a water‑wetted slide against it, tilted 45°, ready for dropping.

steps.title: Drop cell suspension onto slides
steps.instruction: Using a plastic Pasteur pipette (tip wider than a P1000), draw up the cell suspension, let the first drops fall back into the tube, then dispense several drops onto different areas of the slide while standing. Aim to cover the whole slide, avoid overlapping drops, and keep the drop distance ≈0.5 m to allow nuclei to spread.

steps.title: Fix and incubate slides on heating block
steps.instruction: Immediately after dropping, quickly wash each slide by dropping fixative across it with the Pasteur pipette. Place slides (cell side up) on the humidified 42 °C block for 3 min.

steps.title: Assess spread quality and adjust if needed
steps.instruction: Examine slides under a light microscope; 3–5 metaphases per minute indicates adequate density. If fewer, drop additional suspension; if too many, dilute the sample with fixative and repeat the dropping steps.

steps.title: Air‑dry and mount slides
steps.instruction: Air‑dry slides in a fume hood for a few hours at RT. Add a few drops of ProLong Gold antifade with DAPI to a coverslip, place the coverslip on the slide, avoid bubbles, gently press with tissue, and seal edges with transparent nail polish.

steps.title: Store slides and remaining cell pellet
steps.instruction: Store mounted slides up to 1 week at 4 °C or longer at –20 °C in the dark. Keep the remaining cell suspension in fresh fixative at 4 °C for months.

steps.title: Prepare hydroxyurea, hypotonic, and fixative solutions
steps.instruction: Hydroxyurea stock: dissolve 0.38025 g HU in 5 mL DMSO (1 M), aliquot 0.5 mL, store at –20 °C up to 4 months. Hypotonic solution: make 0.075 M KCl in dH₂O, pre‑warm to 37 °C before each use. Fixative: mix 3 parts methanol with 1 part glacial acetic acid; prepare fresh each time and keep ice‑cold.
